betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Charged Certus Quartz Ore is much rarer than the regular variant, but you need those Charged Crystals for Fluix and everything downstream in AE2.

You have a few options for getting Charged Certus:
§b-§f Mine Charged Certus Quartz Ore directly (rare, Fortune helps)
§b-§f Run regular Certus through a Charger using AE power
§b-§f Drop regular Certus Crystals into water next to Charged Ore for in-world conversion

Every processor, cable, and advanced component in the mod needs Charged Certus. Stockpile it early so you are not bottlenecked later.

§ePS:§f The ore glows slightly in the dark. Handy for spotting it at night while mining deep underground.
